title: Data Engineering
tagline: Build robust data pipelines -- Master ETL processes, big data technologies, and cloud solutions for enterprise data management.
overview: This intensive course prepares you for the high-demand field of data engineering. You'll learn to design, build, and maintain data pipelines using Python, SQL, and modern big data technologies.

The curriculum covers ETL processes, data warehousing, cloud platforms, and real-time data processing. Through hands-on projects, you'll gain experience with industry-standard tools and architectures used by leading tech companies.
learningOutcomes: Design and implement ETL pipelines using Python and SQL
Work with relational and NoSQL databases
Process big data using Apache Spark
Build data warehouses and implement dimensional modeling
Deploy data solutions on cloud platforms (AWS/GCP)
Implement real-time data processing with Kafka
Monitor and optimize data pipeline performance
Ensure data quality and implement data governance
